# iDGen

> iDGen — Identity Solutions, Simplified. iDGen manufactures ID cards, RFID credentials, and lanyards for schools, colleges, universities, and enterprises across Northeast India.

iDGen prints ID cards on durable PVC with edge-to-edge lamination, embeds RFID chips for access-control and library systems, and produces custom-branded lanyards. Bulk orders are printed in-house and dispatched across Assam, Meghalaya, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram, Tripura, and Arunachal Pradesh.
